## Design

* [Every run-card field is classified: consumed, benign or refused](field-classification.md) - FIELD_CLASSES gives each of the 209 run-card names Consumed, IgnoredBenign (with a positive inertness argument) or IgnoredPhysics (refused off default); audit method and blind spots.
* [MLM run-card parameters and the xqcut cut rewrites](matching-parameters.md) - ickkw, xqcut, maxjetflavor, pdfwgt, alpsfact and use_syst rules; the ptj = mmjj = xqcut and drjj = drjl = 0 rewrites applied when the card is resolved; and the matching combinations that are refused.
* [MadGraph run_card parsing, defaults and beam modes](run-card-parser-and-defaults.md) - run_card.dat syntax, MadGraph's LO defaults transcribed and checked against a banner.py dump, unknown names as hard errors, the edits applied on resolution, and the two accepted beam modes.

* [MadGraph cut conventions (cuts.f) and what vibegraph implements](madgraph-cut-conventions.md) - Cut families and class membership, rapidity not pseudorapidity, ΔR and mass thresholds as signed squares, lab-frame evaluation, and parse-and-detect refusal of unimplemented cuts.
